_comment: Alarm/status registers captured from the real controller at rest, 2026-08-31,
Generator state at capture time, independently corroborated:
status word 0x004F = 0x6880  -> Off-Ready, Automatic, engine Stopped,
engine speed 0 RPM, battery 13.1 V, utility 235.0 V L-L at 59.90 Hz
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: on this hardware an alarm nibble of 0 means BOTH
'fault asserted' and 'input not populated'. Decoding naively lights up 15
faults on a demonstrably healthy generator. Any condition asserted in THIS
capture is treated as an absent sensor rather than a fault, and generated
Corroborating evidence that these are absent sensors, not real faults:
oil pressure 0x0033, fuel level 0x0035, fuel volume 0x0036 all read 0xFFFF
every L3 register reads 0xFFFF (single-phase 240 V unit)
IF YOU EVER SERVICE THE UNIT OR ADD A SENSOR, RE-CAPTURE THIS FILE and
re-run tools/gen_alarms.py, or a newly-wired input will stay hidden.
